perf.summary: Cache state via top-1 read and avoid recomputing state*symbolCount; already tight but minor hoist possible.
perf.currentCost: Each loop iteration computes stack[top-1] then state*symbolCount + (terminal+1). On a shift, the next iteration reloads stack[top-1] (the just-pushed value). Small redundancy.
perf.proposedChange: Keep the current top-of-stack state in a local `int state` and update it on shift (state = action.Target) and on reduce (state = gotos[...]) instead of re-reading stack[top-1] each iteration. The stack still records states for reduce pops.
perf.rationale: Eliminates one dependent load (stack[top-1]) per LR step, shortening the per-token critical path in the hot driver loop.
perf.risk: On reduce, after `top -= rhsLen`, the new top state is stack[top-1] which must be re-read (it is older, not tracked) — so keep that read on the reduce path; only the shift path benefits from the cached local. Ensure state local is refreshed correctly on both paths to preserve semantics.
